items.name: Old Man's Music Pub
items.hours: Live music ~21:00–23:00 nightly, then DJ till late (guide listings; unconfirmed for 2026)
items.blurb: Sweaty basement, live covers every night, then a DJ and a dancefloor. Proper old-school rock-and-pint chaos with zero airs and graces.
items.tip: Gets rammed by 22:00 on weekends. Go early for a table near the band or accept getting wedged at the bar.

items.name: BARhole Music
items.blurb: Red-lit basement with graffiti walls: punk, rock and metal gigs and tribute nights. Cheap beer, loud guitars, 150-capacity bunker. Your kind of place.
items.tip: A separate 'Saloon' area is open on weekdays for a quieter pint. Check their socials for the Thu–Sat gig line-up.

items.name: Lámpás
items.blurb: Labyrinthine basement across from Gozsdu Udvar with live rock, blues and rockabilly most nights. Free in, cheap beer, no tourist-trap vibe.
items.tip: Autumn is peak programming (summer is quieter), so your October dates are ideal. Back rooms are calmer if the main room is mental.

items.name: Blastbeat Bar
items.blurb: Proper metal dive bar, walls plastered with metal relics. Cheap drinks, loud riffs, scruffy and proud. Not for the faint of heart.
items.tip: Cash-friendly dive: some reviewers flag hygiene, so keep expectations grungy. Pin location approximate; check Maps.

items.name: Dürer Kert
items.hours: Gig nights vary; check the programme (18+ after 23:00)
items.blurb: Budapest's big rock and metal gig complex on the Buda waterfront: three stages plus a garden. Metal, hardcore and big touring bands.
items.tip: Buy tickets in advance and check there is actually a gig on 15–18 Oct. Out of the centre, so take a taxi or tram home.

items.name: A38 Ship
items.address: Petőfi híd, budai hídfő (lower quay), 1117 Budapest
items.blurb: Concert venue and club on a converted Ukrainian stone-carrier ship moored on the Danube. Gigs upstairs, parties below, views for free.
items.tip: Tram 4/6 to Petőfi híd. Check the gig calendar; the deck bar is lovely, but it is a proper ticketed venue on show nights.

items.name: Akvárium Klub
items.blurb: Club and gig venue sunk under Erzsébet tér's pond, right in the centre. Big hall for gigs, small hall for DJs, free metal night in the past.
items.tip: Had a 2026 renovation/summer-closure scare and a programme shift; Oct 2026 shows are listed, but confirm on akvariumklub.hu first.

items.name: BackStage Pub
items.blurb: Small live rock and blues club near Heroes' Square. Tribute bands (KISS, etc.), local covers, a sing-along lock-in vibe.
items.tip: Out past Oktogon so grab a taxi. Pin is approximate (±300m). Gig schedule on backstagepub.hu.

items.name: Rocktogon Club
items.hours: Daily 17:00–04:00; gigs 20:00–22:30 then disco (older listing, check)
items.blurb: Rock club by Oktogon: bands first, rock disco after. Handy if you are staying near the Nagykörút.
items.tip: Listing is undated; confirm it is still trading (Instagram / phone) before you walk over.

items.name: Hard Rock Cafe Budapest
items.blurb: The Hard Rock Cafe, memorabilia and burgers on the corner of Vörösmarty tér. Safe, touristy, good for a feed and a Premier League pre-game.
items.tip: Pricey vs ruin bars. Fine for dinner or a rock-themed pint, not for a big night out.

items.name: Robot Club (Instant-Fogas)
items.address: Akácfa utca 49 (basement under Fogas Kert), 1073 Budapest
items.blurb: One of the last proper rock clubs downtown, a basement under the Instant-Fogas complex with rock-disco nights.
items.tip: Reopened 2017 per old reports; confirm it's still running before you go.

items.name: Szimpla Kert
items.blurb: The original ruin bar (2002): mismatched rooms, a Trabant to drink in, graffiti everywhere. Rite of passage; you will hit it at least once.
items.tip: Free entry, glass deposit. Heaving on Fri–Sat nights, so go at 16:00 for a quieter, photo-friendly first pint. Watch your phone.

items.name: Instant-Fogas
items.hours: Wed–Sat 22:00–06:00 per one guide (others say nightly); free before midnight
items.blurb: Huge party complex: ~18 bars, 7 dancefloors, garden, loads of genres under one roof. This is where the weekend ends at 5am.
items.tip: Free before midnight, small cover after. Pick a floor and stick to it; the maze is easy to get lost in with mates.

items.name: Mazel Tov
items.blurb: Glass-roofed courtyard ruin bar with an Israeli menu and hummus. The 'classy' ruin bar for a proper sit-down feed before the carnage.
items.tip: Cash only was an issue per reviewers: bring forints or check cards first. Book a table for evening dining.

items.name: Kőleves Kert
items.hours: Garden season Apr–Oct; evening hours unconfirmed
items.blurb: Garden bar attached to the Kőleves restaurant: chilled ruin-bar courtyard, grill, and a relaxed crowd. Less rowdy than Szimpla.
items.tip: Seasonal and weather-dependent, so check it is open (Facebook) given the mid-October date. Closed Mondays per a 2026 guide.

items.name: Csendes Létterem
items.blurb: Vintage-style ruin pub in the Inner City: bohemian, intimate, good for chatting rather than shouting. Great pre-Szimpla warm-up.
items.tip: Closes at midnight, so it's a pre-game, not a finisher. Ten minutes' walk from the Jewish Quarter.

items.name: Anker't
items.blurb: Big ruin-bar courtyard with room for 800 on a Friday. Calmer than Szimpla, cocktails and loud tunes.
items.tip: Sources differ on its seasonal status; confirm it is open in October before heading over. Pin approximate.

items.name: Doboz
items.blurb: Labyrinth of rooms with eight music styles, a grill bar and two dancefloors. Cheap and fun until sunrise.
items.tip: 18+ with ID. Entry may include a drink on ticketed nights. Check hours as only reseller listings confirm them.

items.name: Ellátó Kert
items.blurb: Classic courtyard ruin bar and taqueria on Kazinczy. Chill, cheap drinks and pub grub.
items.tip: It closed in 2019 and reopened later; the status is from undated listings, so confirm before heading over.

items.name: Red Ruin
items.blurb: Communist-kitsch ruin pub in a brick basement: pop-art propaganda, puns, 'people's prices'. Gloriously daft.
items.tip: Easy to miss the basement entrance, near Ferenciek tere. Walk-in only.

items.name: Karaván Street Food Court
items.blurb: Courtyard of food trucks next door to Szimpla: langos, burgers, kürtőskalács and a beer. Perfect for lining your stomach.
items.tip: Longest queues at lángos and chimney cake. Eat here before Szimpla, not after.

items.name: Hotsy Totsy
items.blurb: 1920s cellar speakeasy with architecture-themed cocktails and a hidden private room. Dress up slightly, behave properly.
items.tip: Walk-in seating only: arrive early Thu–Sat. Cocktails ~3,500–5,000 HUF.

items.name: The Magic
items.blurb: Wizarding-themed den that nails the atmosphere. Butterbeer-ish potions and food; fun daytime wild card if one of you is a Potter nerd.
items.tip: Book ahead, especially weekends. More restaurant than boozer: close early-ish.

items.name: For Sale Pub
items.blurb: Walls and ceiling covered in scribbled notes and peanut shells. Sit, drink, leave your mark. Across from the Central Market Hall.
items.tip: Book ahead if eating at weekends. Cheaper and calmer than the Jewish Quarter.

items.name: Gozsdu Udvar
items.blurb: Passage of seven connected courtyards packed with bars, terraces and restaurants. Easy bar-hop in one go.
items.tip: Touristy and pricier than basement bars; good first stop to meet up before heading off.

items.name: Boutiq'Bar
items.blurb: Long-running (since 2008) cocktail bar with a bartender's-choice menu. Smart, grown-up pre-game or post-dinner nightcap.
items.tip: Mixed drinks ~€12–16. Book ahead for Fri and Sat. Address from memory; confirm.

items.name: High Note SkyBar
items.blurb: Rooftop at the Aria Hotel with eye-level views of the Basilica dome. Splash out for sunset cocktails and a photo that will wind up your mates.
items.tip: Smart casual, no gym wear or flip-flops. Cocktails ~5,900–6,200 HUF. Book a sunset table.

items.name: 360 Bar
items.blurb: Rooftop terrace over Andrássy Avenue with a genuine 360-degree skyline. Great for a mid-afternoon pint or a pre-club cocktail.
items.tip: Discreet street door, take the lift to the 6th floor. Small cover (~1,000 HUF) Thu–Sun per one guide.

items.name: Élesztő
items.blurb: Huge craft beer house with dozens of Hungarian taps in the Ferencváros. Beer geek heaven with no pretension.
items.tip: Not confirmed this session; verify it's open on your night. Out of the Jewish Quarter by tram/metro.

items.name: Champs Sports Pub
items.hours: Opens around noon; late-night (check match days)
items.blurb: Many screens, Jewish Quarter location, opens at midday unlike most bars nearby. Football on every wall.
items.tip: Pin approximate to the street (house number unconfirmed). Check which matches are being shown on the 17th and 18th Oct.

stripWarning: Budapest strip clubs are notorious for scams: inflated bills of hundreds or thousands of euros, forced 'tabs', and heavies at the door. Hungarian police and the US Embassy have warned about it. Never follow street promoters or anyone who approaches you. Agree prices in writing, pay per drink, never hand over your card. We list none.

leads.name: Jack Doyle's Irish Bar
leads.note: Has a Sky Sports contract and stays open to 3am for late matches (tight, book ahead). Address/coords not confirmed.

leads.name: Stifler American Sport Bar
leads.note: Nagykörút, open to 5am per a 2020 guide; address unconfirmed.

leads.name: Bajor Sport Pub & Gastro
leads.note: Margit körút (Buda); Champions League and Hungarian matches; address unconfirmed.

leads.name: Ziccer! (TrollFoci)
leads.note: Football bar on the Nagykörút; address unconfirmed.

leads.name: Kaledonia Gastro & Sports Pub
leads.note: Scottish-themed sports bar in Pest per 2025 guide; unconfirmed.

leads.name: Ötkert
leads.note: Zrínyi utca 4, V; Classic late-night club (nightly); not confirmed in this research session.

leads.name: Analog Music Hall
leads.note: Kondorfa utca 8, XI; metal/rock gigs (e.g. GHØSTKID 13 Oct 2026); far out. Exact coords not confirmed.

leads.name: Barba Negra Music Club
leads.note: Szállító utca 3 (Csepel/XXI); big touring rock acts; nothing for 15–18 Oct found (Simple Plan is 21 Oct).

leads.name: Hunnia Bisztró
leads.note: Basement bar with Hungarian bands Fri/Sat; address unconfirmed.

leads.name: 202 Music Club (ex-Wigwam)
leads.note: XI; rock party until dawn after weekend gigs; address unconfirmed.

leads.name: Kobuci Kert
leads.note: Óbuda courtyard venue (Zichy Palace); seasonal, mostly closed outside summer.

leads.name: Hintaló
leads.note: Character bar in District VIII; unconfirmed.

leads.note: DROPPED: closed permanently Oct 2021 (building now Mika Tivadar Secret Museum).
